_comment: Release toolchain pin (release audit B2). A release build must be reproducible from
the public commit alone, so the publish script REFUSES to build unless the resolved
toolchain matches these values exactly. Changing any of them is a deliberate re-pin:
edit this file, rebuild, and re-verify byte-identical reproduction from two fresh
sdkVersion is additionally enforced by global.json (rollForward: disable); the runtime
pack patch by UI.csproj (KnownRuntimePack); the NuGet graph by exact PackageReference
versions, recorded per release in LICENSE-INVENTORY.md (regenerated, diffed and shipped
by the publish) and hashed into each package's BUILDINFO.txt.
